## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to press the smooth gray base switch

Task description: The target is the small rectangular switch on the front of the smooth light-gray base at the left of the table. Use the left arm to press the movable tab and toggle the switch.

Success criteria: Use the left arm to press the switch rocker fully, reaching near the end of its target toggle travel. Merely touching the rocker or deflecting it slightly does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider closing the left gripper and contacting the movable panel with one fingertip to reduce the risk of both fingers spanning the base plate and interfering with an effective press.
- Test-press the raised end of the rocker slightly, keeping the contact point within its end outline and away from the narrow edge and pivot to reduce slipping and gain enough leverage to flip it.
- Press inward based on the actual front orientation of the base plate, avoiding sliding across the plate or the fingertip hitting the surrounding base first.
- Make small contact-direction adjustments as the switch tab turns, observing whether it is near the end of its travel. Avoid continuing to push after the pads slip or forcing it once it has reached its limit.
